entry.title: New: Co-Engram
entry.summary: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6. Exact install spec: github:co-engram/co-engram. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
